I decided to cancel the subscription on the Apple App Store in settings like I’ve always done in the past. I confirmed it was cancelled then moved on and didn’t think anything more until I got a surprise charge on my card 8 days later for $30. I was surprised so went to check and found that it said cancelled next charge is Nov 28?  Why would it show as cancelled and next charge date. That didn’t make sense. My only thinking is maybe I cancelled too quickly and apple software screwed up and got the subscription renewal setup after the cancellation. I don’t know. 

I cancelled it again and it said cancelled as of today on the 28th. So then I complained to polycom but they were useless. Just said you have to cancel on the Apple app. I complained to Apple and they said here’s $22.   ☹️. So not even a review of the software because I didn’t even get to really use it. But more of a review of the apple subscription service which I wish I could leave a review for but where do you do that?

I accidentally signed up for the annual Business plan, believing I was starting a seven-day trial. I then faced an annual charge of 370, which I cannot afford. The payment was declined, and I’ve spent approximately two weeks trying to cancel without getting a resolution.

I used the service for only one day, but I am willing to pay for a full month to resolve this fairly. I do not want an annual subscription.

Support directed me back to the cancellation page and repeated the no-refund policy, despite my explanation that the payment had not gone through.

Warning to other users: Polycam’s policy states that website subscription payments are non-refundable. Check the plan, billing period, and total price carefully before subscribing.

The app itself is good, but my experience trying to resolve this billing issue has been extremely frustrating.

reviews.title: A remarkably poor way to treat potential paying customers.
reviews.text:
Polycam offers a 7-day free trial. Unfortunately, once you start using it, you quickly discover that many of the features you might actually want to evaluate are locked behind a higher subscription tier.

So I upgraded. I was already within my 7-day free trial, so I reasonably expected to be able to try the higher tier and decide whether it justified the considerable subscription cost.

Instead, I was charged £29.99 immediately.

The fact that upgrading would effectively end my free trial and result in an immediate £29.99 charge was certainly not made clear enough before I did it.

And apparently I am far from alone.

After this happened, I went back and properly read through the App Store reviews. There are numerous recent reviews raising similar complaints about subscriptions, charging and the very high monthly and annual costs.

Interestingly, Apple doesn’t display reviews by “Most Recent” by default. They are shown by “Most Helpful”.

It was only when I manually changed the sorting to “Most Recent” that I started seeing these complaints.

So my advice to anyone considering Polycam is very simple:

CHANGE THE REVIEWS TO “MOST RECENT” BEFORE STARTING A TRIAL OR SUBSCRIBING.

Read the experiences of recent customers and make your own decision.

As for the trial itself, this really shouldn’t be complicated. If changing subscription tier during an active free trial is going to immediately end that trial and trigger a payment, the customer should be presented with an unmistakab

Maybe it didnt go through. I honestly still dont know.  A week later I got charged for the yearly subscription.  I immediately went to Apple and canceled the subscription and requested a refund. Denied. Tried again. Denied again. Appealed it. Denied again.  Then I saw online people saying you could maybe email Tim Cook directly for stuff like this so I emailed him like 5 times. Never got a response. Never got a refund.  To this day it still bothers me. I still think about that money and how useful it would be right now. Im literally sitting here at 2am still thinking about it while writing this review.  So yeah just make sure if you do the free trial you actually cancel it and make sure it’s gone because you won’t be able to get it back 💔

reviews.title: Polycam 3D Scanner
reviews.text:
Would have liked to write a review, but after spending ages to capture my subject, I pressed upload and it bombed at 76%. Once, might have been understandable… but five damn times! 🤬
Draw your own conclusions on my opinion of this app.

reviews.title: Not Free
reviews.text: Don’t say in app purchases or show cost, but is not free.

reviews.title: Don’t trust the free trial
reviews.text: They instantly charged my account £149.99 even though it said start a free 7 day trial. Now going through the process to get my money back. What a SCAM! Don’t make the same mistake. Not good enough.

reviews.title: Complete fraud steals money via apple
reviews.text: Zero stars took money from account without permission this has had the effect that I have had to cancel my Christmas food order leavening a disabled veteran without food this Christmas

reviews.title: Doesn’t work on m2 iPad
reviews.text: When you click record, it takes you back to the homepage. Subscribing also doesn’t seem to change anything, it keeps the upgrade button in the top right and restoring purchases reloads the app but changes nothing. Will receives once the bugs are fixed
